harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied apodosis (jawāb), i.e. "such-and-such will take place".

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «لوقعتها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ليس», whose noun (ism) is «كاذبة», and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الواقعة».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «خافضة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it", and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الْوَاقِعَةُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إذا» is a badal (substitute) from the earlier «إذا» and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فكانت» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «بُسَّتْ»; «منبثَّا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «هباء».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the interrogative clause «ما أصحاب», made up of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is the khabar of «أصحاب».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: (وأصحاب المشأمة ما أصحاب المشأمة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the preceding clause.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «والسابقون»: the wāw is conjunctive; «السابقون» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the second «السابقون» is a tawkīd (emphasis).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «أولئك المقربون» is the khabar (predicate) of {السَّابِقُونَ}, and the clause of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause in verse (8).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition «في جنات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {الْمُقَرَّبُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «ثلة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are a throng", and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الْمُقَرَّبُونَ}; the preposition «من الأولين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ثلة».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «وقليل»: a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «ثلة», and the preposition «من الآخرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قليل».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The preposition «على سرر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هم», i.e. "they are a throng upon couches".

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: (متكئين عليها متقابلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] Two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «على سرر», i.e. "they being upon couches, reclining"; the preposition «عليها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متكئين».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «يطوف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in {مُتَقَابِلِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The preposition «بأكواب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَطُوفُ}; the preposition «من معين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كأس».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «لا يُصَدَّعون» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «كأس».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: His words «وفاكهة»: a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «أكواب»; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فاكهة».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «لحم».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «حور» is mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted by its being qualified; the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "they have".

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition «كأمثال» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «حور».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «جزاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (جزاء).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «قيلا» is excepted with a disconnected exception (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ); «سلاما» is a badal (substitute), and the second «سلاما» is a verbal tawkīd (emphasis) (tawkīd lafẓī).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The wāw is resumptive; «أصحاب» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «ما أصحاب اليمين» is the khabar (predicate) of «أصحاب».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «في سدر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate) of the first «أصحاب».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «لا مقطوعة»: «لا» is negative, and «مقطوعة» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «فاكهة»; the second «لا» is redundant (zāʾida); «ممنوعة» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «مقطوعة».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: (لأصحاب اليمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلناهن».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «ثلة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they".

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The preposition «من الآخرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ثلة».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «أصحاب» is mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «ما أصحاب الشمال», and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause in verse (27).

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: (في سموم وحميم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) {أَصْحَابُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «لا بارد»: «لا» is negative; «بارد» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يحموم».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: (إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; the adverb «قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مترفين».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «إذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "we will be raised", and the clause «إنا لمبعوثون» explains the implied verb.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The wāw is conjunctive; «آباؤنا» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "will be raised"; the clause (آباؤنا مبعوثون) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «إنا لمبعوثون».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The preposition «إلى ميقات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مجموعون».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ثم إنكم لآكلون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the preceding maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying), and the vocative clause is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «لآكلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; the preposition «من شجر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آكلون»; the preposition «مِنْ زَقُّوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شجر».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «فمالئون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آكلون»; the preposition «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مالئون»; «البطون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مالئون».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «فشاربون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «مالئون», and the two prepositions are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شاربون».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نزلهم», and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «فلولا تُصًدَّقون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «نحن خلقناكم»; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The clause «أفرأيتم» is resumptive; its two objects are «ما» and the clause {أَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «أم» is the connected (muttaṣila) one. As for a clause occurring after it, they answered that the khabar (predicate) coming after «نحن» was brought by way of emphasis; supporting its being connected is that the statement calls for "which of the two matters is the case?", so what follows it is a clause interpreted as a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «نحن قَدَّرْنا» is resumptive, and the clause «ما نحن بمسبوقين» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive (majrūr) and attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسبوقين».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The wāw is resumptive; the clause «فلولا تذكَّرون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «علمتم»; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «أفرأيتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to its counterpart in verse (58), and the two objects of the verb are «ما» and the following interrogative clause.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: (أأنتم تزرعونه أم نحن الزارعون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] See the i'rab of verse (59).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فظلتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «لجعلناه»; «ظلتم» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb from which one of its two lāms was dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «إنا لمغرمون» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an omitted saying, and the clause of the omitted saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in {تَفَكَّهُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: (بل نحن محرومون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «أفرأيتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to its counterpart in verse (63), and its two objects are «الماء» and the following interrogative clause.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: (أأنتم أنزلتموه من المزن أم نحن المنزلون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] See the i'rab of verse (59).

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فلولا تشكرون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «جعلناه»; «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «أفرأيتم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to its counterpart in verse (68), and its two objects are «النار» and the interrogative clause.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «نحن جعلناها» is resumptive; «تذكرة» is the second object; the preposition «للمقوين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «متاعا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «فسبح باسم ربك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «فلا أقسم» is resumptive; «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The wāw is parenthetical, and the clause (وإنه لقسم عظيم) is parenthetical between «أقسم» and its response; the clause «لو تعلمون» is parenthetical between the adjective and the noun it qualifies, and the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو» is omitted, its implied form being "you would have believed".

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: (إنه لقرآن كريم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause of the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The preposition «في كتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «قرآن».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «لا يمسُّه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرآن».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «تنزيل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرآن»; the preposition «من رب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «تنزيل».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; the preposition «بهذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مدهنون», and the clause «أنتم مدهنون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «وتجعلون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the single-word khabar (predicate) {مُدْهِنُونَ}, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) that governs the later verb «ترجعونها»; his words «فلولا ترجعونها» refer to the soul. «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the later verb «ترجعونها».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: (وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «حين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «تنظرون».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: (ونحن أقرب إليه منكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "you look on in this state"; the two prepositions are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقرب», and the clause «ولكن لا تُبصرون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «تنظرون».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «فلولا» is a verbal tawkīd (emphasis) of its counterpart in verse (83). The conditional clause «إن كنتم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by {تَرْجِعُونَهَا}; its place is originally earlier, i.e. "if you are not to be judged, then bring back the departing soul".

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «ترجعونها» is resumptive; its place is originally after the first «لولا». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring back the soul".

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: (فأما إن كان من المقربين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive; «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: His words «فروح»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and «روح» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then his recompense is rest"; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «أمَّا», and the apodosis of «إن» is omitted, indicated by the apodosis [of «أمَّا»].

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «وأما إن كان ... » is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «إن كان من المقربين».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and «سلام» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «إمَّا» [Translator's note: so written in the source; «أمَّا» is meant], and the apodosis of «إنْ» is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of «إمَّا». The preposition «من أصحاب» is attached to the implied notion of being (istiqrār) to which «لك» is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); «نزل» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then his recompense is a hospitality"; the preposition «من حميم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نزل».

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «لهو حق» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
